//: The build profile this toolkit assumes. Copy the `preview` profile into your
distribution: internal is the load-bearing setting.
- On Android it switches the default gradle command to produce an APK.
An .aab is NOT installable from a link, so a profile without this
silently serves a file nobody can install.
- On iOS it produces an ad hoc build, whose provisioning profile bakes in
a device UDID allow-list AT BUILD TIME. Register testers with
`refresh-ad-hoc-provisioning-profile: true` when you add someone new.
